subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.11 published dist missing reentrancy guard - reply session initialization conflicted

question: Should maintainers ship a stable replacement for v2026.6.11 with the current reply-session/store-writer fixes, or keep this issue open until the next stable release supersedes it?
rationale: The source fix is already on main, but npm latest and GitHub latest stable still serve the affected package; choosing whether and how to republish/supersede stable is a release-owner decision, not an autonomous source patch.

options.title: Ship stable replacement
options.body: Cut a corrected stable release, verify npm tarball parity and reply-session smoke behavior, and close this issue with the new version.

options.title: Defer to next stable
options.body: Keep this issue open and document v2026.6.11 as affected until the next planned stable release is published and proven clean.

options.title: Split release guard work
options.body: Track package/dist parity smoke coverage separately if maintainers want this issue to remain only the affected-stable tracker.

recommendation.title: Ship stable replacement
recommendation.body: Cut a corrected stable release, verify npm tarball parity and reply-session smoke behavior, and close this issue with the new version.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is release/package parity, and this person authored the latest stable release-tag commit currently serving affected users.
